release_notes:
## Authored Knight — first playable replacement

Replaces the Knight runtime-built body/armor with an exported weighted character: open helmet, visible face, shaped armor, gloves, boots, sword, shield, blinking eyes and a moving coral plume. Menus and gameplay use the same imported model. Existing controls, progression, saves and fixed-per-run character choice are preserved.

This remains a first art pass, below the concept sheet finish. Gargoyle and Witch retain their previous treatment. Final textures, expression and animation polish, and physical-phone performance review remain open.

Verification: 802 local assertions; all 148 navigation checks also passed with actual rendered GUI input. All three heroes passed 3,600-tick basic-only runs. A sixty-second actual desktop Knight recording covered 1,312.707 meters with zero damage or handoffs. All 108 runtime source hashes in the GitHub compilation match the reviewed source.

The APK preserves the existing app signing identity and passed signature, package, ZIP and 16 KB archive/native alignment checks.
